title: Video Editing Services for New York City Businesses
metaTitle: Video Editing Services in New York City | TDM
metaDescription: Video editing for New York City brands: ad cuts, reels, product and brand videos, captions and every platform format, edited remotely from TDM's Lahore hub.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) edits video for New York City businesses: ad cuts, reels and short-form clips, product videos, brand films and creator footage. Editing runs from our hub in Lahore, and we work with New York clients entirely remotely. You send the footage, whether it came from a phone, a creator or a professional shoot, and receive finished videos in the formats each platform needs. A great deal of footage is filmed in this city and never used. Editing is how it starts earning its keep.

sections.heading: New York has plenty of footage and too few finished videos
paragraphs: A restaurant in the East Village films a new dish every week. A broker walks through a Brooklyn brownstone with a phone on a gimbal. A fitness studio in Chelsea records classes, and a founder in Flatiron has hours of interviews and panel talks. Capturing the material is rarely the hard part. The hard part is turning it into something a stranger will watch past the first two seconds, week after week, when the owner has a business to run.

Competition for attention is severe. New Yorkers scroll past content from every restaurant, shop and studio within a few blocks, as well as national brands with large budgets. Clips that hold up share some habits: they open on the most interesting moment, they are captioned for people watching on a silent train, and they are cut to the pace of the platform they appear on.

sections.heading: What our editors do
paragraphs: We begin by reviewing what you have and telling you honestly what it can support. If there is a gap that a short pickup shot would fix, we flag it early. First cuts come back as a batch for review, and you respond with timestamped notes.
bullets: Hook-first ad cuts for Meta, TikTok and YouTube, with several opening variations per concept.
Vertical short-form edits with tight pacing and on-screen text, delivered in batches against a content calendar.
Longer product and brand videos, colour-graded and sound-designed, for websites and YouTube.
Burned-in captions, animated text, logo stings, price tags and end cards.
Every master exported in the ratios and lengths each placement requires, named to your convention.

sections.heading: Working with an editing team outside the city
paragraphs: Editing does not need to happen near the place the footage was shot. Files are uploaded, cuts are reviewed in a browser, and feedback is written against the timeline. Because our editors are many hours ahead of New York, work often moves forward outside your business day, and notes sent in the evening can be picked up while the city sleeps.

What matters more than location is who the editors sit beside. Ours work next to the team that runs paid campaigns. For clients whose ads we manage, editors see how long viewers stay with each cut and how often they click, and they re-edit the weak openings. In a market where advertising is expensive, a better first three seconds is one of the few savings fully within your control.

sections.heading: Before you send footage to any editor
paragraphs: Agree which platforms the videos are for, and in which lengths. Check that you hold the rights to any music in the raw footage, and that people who appear on camera have given consent. Settle how many revision rounds are included and how files will be delivered. For regulated fields such as finance, law and health, decide who signs off on wording before anything is published.

presence: TDM works with New York City businesses remotely and has no office, studio or editor in the city. All editing is carried out at our Lahore hub, with footage and review cuts exchanged online.

faqs.q: Can you edit footage I filmed on my phone in my New York shop or restaurant?
faqs.a: Yes. Many clients send phone footage, creator submissions or archive material. We review it, tell you what it can support and point out any gaps a short extra shot would close.

faqs.q: How much does video editing cost for a New York business?
faqs.a: It depends on scope: the number of videos, their length, the graphics involved and how many variants are needed. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How quickly can edits be turned around?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief and the volume of footage, and the schedule is agreed in the plan. Because our editors work ahead of New York time, progress often happens outside your working hours.

Each approved edit is exported in the ratios its placements require: vertical for reels, stories and TikTok, square and portrait for feeds, and widescreen for YouTube and websites, with captioned and clean versions where needed.

faqs.q: Do you film in New York as well as edit?
faqs.a: Editing is a separate service handled entirely from our hub. If you also need new footage, our video shoot service covers planning and scripting, with filming arranged locally for each project.
